natural_language_analysis.summary: All three VCs are semantically valid. They share one list-segment decomposition/reassembly family and can be handled by one worker in manual-witness order.

vc_shape.pre_exists: The xizi_dll definition hides sentinel first/last; the whole dllseg hides every successor.
vc_shape.post_spatial: Sentinel links, prefix dllseg ending at linklist_node_pre, the node's next/prev links, and suffix dllseg ending at the sentinel (or the corresponding segment-only disjunct).
vc_shape.post_exists: Instantiate first/last from xizi_dll opening, node_prev as the predecessor at the prefix boundary, and node_next as the successor stored in linklist_node_pre.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Open xizi_dll to obtain first and last, then split the dllseg whose logical list is nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after. The split supplies node_prev and node_next.
witnesses.space_plan: Apply xizi_dll_open (or unfold xizi_dll), preserve the sentinel links, and use an induction/helper over nodes_before to split the whole dllseg at linklist_node_pre. Cancel the resulting four components against the selected full-list post disjunct.
witnesses.pure_plan: The required node non-null fact is exactly PreH2. During dllseg induction, each nonempty constructor supplies current-node equality, non-nullness, and inequality from the segment stop; no arithmetic is required.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No refinement or safeExec state is present.
premise_discharge: The helper's input segment is obtained by opening the precondition xizi_dll.
The distinguished node occurrence is supplied by the list identity nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after; constructor guards are internal facts of xizi_dllseg.
witnesses.failure_signal: None; a failure to split would be a proof-engineering issue, not a missing semantic premise.
witnesses.grouping_reason: This is the decomposition half of the same segment-boundary helper family used in both return VCs.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Sentinel links plus prefix dllseg, linklist_node_pre links with node_next, and suffix dllseg node_next linklist_node_pre linklist_pre last nodes_after (or the corresponding segment-only shape).
vc_shape.pre_exists: No new pre existential; first, last, node_prev, and node_next are universally introduced witness parameters.
vc_shape.post_spatial: Reconstructed xizi_dll linklist_pre (nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after), or reconstructed enclosing dllseg in the segment-only disjunct.
vc_shape.post_exists: For xizi_dll closing, reuse first and last; segment reconstruction uses the existing node_next and node_prev.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Choose the full-list disjunct. Reuse first/last when closing xizi_dll after joining prefix, the distinguished node links, and suffix.
witnesses.space_plan: Destruct nodes_after. If nonempty, unfolding the suffix dllseg exposes node_next <> linklist_pre, contradicting PreH1. Therefore nodes_after = nil. Join prefix dllseg, node links, and the empty suffix segment, then combine with sentinel links and apply xizi_dll_close.
witnesses.pure_plan: For nodes_after = nil, unfold xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value and simplify to 0 = 0. The cons case contradiction uses PreH1 (node_next = linklist_pre) and the nonempty dllseg guard node_next <> stop.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No refinement or safeExec state is present.
premise_discharge: For the selected full-list disjunct, linklist_node_pre <> linklist_pre follows from the separated sentinel and node link cells; equality would overlap identical node_next/node_prev addresses.
The prefix segment, node links, and suffix segment are all explicit precondition resources.
witnesses.failure_signal: None; the sentinel equality forces the logical suffix to be empty.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Uses the reassembly half of the same helper family and the nil-suffix branch of the case-specific return-value definition.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: Sentinel links plus prefix dllseg, linklist_node_pre links, and suffix dllseg; the refined disjunct additionally exposes nodes_after = node_next :: l0 and the node_next links/rest segment.
vc_shape.pre_pure: node_next <> linklist_pre, linklist_node_pre <> 0, and in the refined arm nodes_after = node_next :: l0.
vc_shape.pre_exists: The refined symbolic-execution arm exposes next and l0 from unfolding the nonempty suffix segment.
vc_shape.post_spatial: The original xizi_dll/list-segment shape for nodes_before ++ linklist_node_pre :: nodes_after.
vc_shape.post_exists: Reuse first/last for xizi_dll closing; use node_next as the head of nodes_after and next as its physical successor.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: The suffix cannot be nil because a nil dllseg would imply node_next = linklist_pre, contradicting the guard. Thus instantiate nodes_after as node_next :: l0 (as already exposed by the refined disjunct).
witnesses.space_plan: Select a provable full-list arm, expose the nonempty suffix when needed, retain its links/rest as the suffix dllseg, join prefix + linklist_node_pre links + suffix, and close with the unchanged sentinel links.
witnesses.pure_plan: Destruct nodes_after. The nil case contradicts the dllseg nil equality node_next = stop together with PreH1. In the cons case, xizi_dllseg head equality identifies the first logical element with node_next; unfolding xizi_double_link_next_rec_last_value then yields reflexivity.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No refinement or safeExec state is present.
premise_discharge: For a selected full-list arm, linklist_node_pre <> linklist_pre follows from separation of sentinel and node link fields.
node_next <> linklist_pre is the branch guard and justifies suffix unfolding/nonemptiness.
witnesses.failure_signal: None; the guard and dllseg definition force nodes_after to begin with node_next.
witnesses.grouping_reason: Uses the same segment reassembly helper as return_wit_1, with the nonempty-suffix branch of the value definition.

analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Open/split or join/close xizi_dllseg at the distinguished linklist_node_pre boundary.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: Use the common dllseg split/join family; retain sentinel links unchanged and close xizi_dll for return witnesses.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Unfold the case-specific value definition after proving nodes_after is nil exactly in the sentinel branch and is headed by node_next in the non-sentinel branch.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: Same function, same dllseg boundary, same helper family, and only three witnesses; one group is the minimal policy-compliant plan.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: xizi_dllseg first prev stop last (prefix ++ node :: suffix) |-- EX node_prev node_next, xizi_dllseg first prev node node_prev prefix ** xizi_dll_links node node_next node_prev ** xizi_dllseg node_next node stop last suffix

premises.premise: The source logical list is prefix ++ node :: suffix.
premises.discharged_by: The entail witness precondition after xizi_dll_open.
premises.spatial_resource: the whole xizi_dllseg from first to stop

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: node <> NULL -> node <> stop -> xizi_dllseg first prev node node_prev prefix ** xizi_dll_links node node_next node_prev ** xizi_dllseg node_next node stop last suffix |-- xizi_dllseg first prev stop last (prefix ++ node :: suffix)

premises.discharged_by: In the selected full-list arm, equality would make the separated sentinel and node link points-to cells overlap; separation entailment establishes the contradiction.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove a suffix-scoped split helper and join helper by induction on prefix. Use split for entail_wit_1. For return_wit_1, show nodes_after=nil from node_next=sentinel and the dllseg constructor guard, join the segments, and close xizi_dll. For return_wit_2, show nodes_after=node_next::rest from node_next<>sentinel, simplify the value definition, join, and close.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All witnesses belong to one function and one dllseg boundary/helper family; 3 <= 12, so one group is both minimal and controller-policy compliant.
